externalReply.text: Selma, the earlier all-data and zero-downtime assurances cannot be supported. Noor Voss owns the correction and will send a category matrix and export start status by 14:30 UTC today. Production content is in Frankfurt and Dublin, but identity, telemetry, the historical US support attachment and PDF Preview have separate processing paths. Overseas assignment and attachment rendering are recorded for the trial case; full individual viewing detail is unavailable. The trial spreadsheet includes real contact information. The team cannot issue an all-data EU-only certificate or move everything before tomorrow’s review.

The proposed course is to prioritize your independent export and prepare a controlled transition, rather than ask you to rely on an unsupported migration deadline. Your existing permission allows the encrypted snapshot to be prepared for Selma and Pavel at the verified EU landing zone, and permits Pavel to disable PDF Preview after saving the manifest. Noor will confirm those states by 14:30. Export includes work orders, attachments and acknowledgement events with a manifest; it does not include vendor caches or turn the landing zone into the live collaboration product. Progress is due tomorrow at 09:00, and the first snapshot is estimated within twenty-four hours of its actual start.

No write freeze or cancellation has been made. At today’s 15:30 call, the team will ask whether you want to approve read-only transition after the September 18 inspection batch, with new work recorded in your worksheet and reconciled by Pavel. Read-only access still uses the global directory and telemetry. It is a practical retrieval bridge, not an EU-only solution. If you select cancellation, the current term can end September 30 with the contractual thirty-day export access; source deletion will require a separate instruction and preservation review. The support attachment and immutable backups cannot be promised erased immediately.

The team can spend the approved EUR 12,000 on export and transition help without renewal. A free October extension is separately available if you need more time and accept by September 25; it carries the existing processing limits. Noor will request manual review of the unissued annual invoice and confirm it today. No next-term payment has been collected. Legal’s initial annex interpretation note is due tomorrow at 08:30, and Privacy and Security will continue answering the historical processing questions even if you leave. The 14:30 matrix will identify gaps your panel needs to see.
